category_override: disputed or partial; not a resolution
notes: Known partial: |F| <= c_k n for every fixed k (Knill, Graphs Combin. 10 (1994) 145-157 via k-wise laminar families; independent proof Tomon arXiv:2603.05443, which records Knill's priority). c_k in these proofs is far from O(k); the stated Ckn form remains open. Outside Lean: everything (citation).

sources.cite: E. Knill, Families of sets with locally bounded width, Graphs and Combinatorics 10 (1994) 145-157
sources.what: k-wise laminar families have size O_k(n), hence O_k(n) for k-cross-free

sources.cite: I. Tomon, Cross-free families have linear size, arXiv:2603.05443
sources.what: new proof of O_k(n); notes Knill's priority

prior_art.note: Linear for fixed k is known since 1994; O(kn) open.
